Subject: Quick recap + ask: who signs off on budget?

Jordan — thanks again for your time today. Short recap from our call and a couple of asks so we can keep momentum.

Call highlights:
- Primary use case: customer support triage + automated summarization for high-volume tickets (60k/mo).
- Success metrics: <10% latency impact to UI, sustained throughput of ~8 reqs/sec per region, and 15–20% reduction in human triage time.
- Security needs: SOC2 evidence, data retention policy, VPC connectivity for private deployment.

Asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer / budget owner we should be working with for purchase? You mentioned finance and IT are both involved; if you can share a name/email that helps set the right cadence.
2) Please introduce your procurement contact so we can share the standard commercial terms and a checklist for legal.
3) I attached a short requirements checklist and an initial trial proposal (PDF). If you want a ballpark pricing range to share internally, tell me the expected monthly token volume and target latency and I’ll produce a 3-tier option.

I’ve cc'd Priya since there were some architecture questions; happy to set a 20-min tech call next week if helpful.

Thanks — Hannah
